description: Daily lowest price of a product across compared shops for up to 365 days (the last point, today, is the product price the product page shows as its main price), plus every current offer with its capture time. `product` is the slug from find_best_price (`product.slug`) or a product id. Use it to say whether today's price is a low, and how much it moved. `price_verdict` {level low|usual|high|short_history|stale, percentile, days, basis} rates the latest price against the last 90 days of our own captured daily lows (no judgement under 14 days; never a discount claim); find_best_price carries the same object. Next: find_best_price for the current recommendation.

currency.description: Currency of the points. Default: the currency of the first offer.

deliver_to_country.description: Country whose shown price is the last point (today). Default: the country of the currency.

product.description: Product slug or id from find_best_price.

name: price_history
title: Price history of a product
